newsitem.title: USA: Odwalla Inc. chief operating officer resigns.
newsitem.headline: Odwalla Inc. chief operating officer resigns.

text.p: Juice-maker Odwalla Inc said Friday that Michael Young, senior vice president and chief operating officer, had resigned.
The company said Young was leaving Odwalla to "pursue personal interests," and that it had no immediate plans to replace him. A company spokesperson was not immediately available for further comment.
In January, Odwalla reported a $4.8 million first quarter loss, reflecting costs associated with the company's recall of some of its juice products after a bacterial outbreak.
Odwalla was linked to an outbreak of E. coli last October in which 50 people were sickened by the bacteria, many of them after drinking Odwalla apple juice.
One child died from complications said to result from drinking Odwalla juice.

The juice-maker, which built a business on producing wholesome natural juices, recalled 16 of its products immediately after the first E. coli cases were reported, removing them from 4,600 stores in its distribution region.
The company later reintroduced the affected products using flash-pasteurized apple juice.
